factory.name: Button.enhance | Button.create
factory.signature: Button.enhance<E extends HTMLButtonElement | HTMLAnchorElement>(element: E, options?: ButtonOptions): Button<E>; Button.create(options?: ButtonOptions & { text?: string; type?: 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset' }, doc?: Document): Button<HTMLButtonElement>

options.name: loading
options.description: Busy state: aria-disabled, activation blocked, spinner shown, 'Loading' added to the accessible name.

options.name: fullWidth
options.description: Stretch to the full inline size of the container.

options.name: disabled
options.description: Disabled state (since 0.9.0). Links: aria-disabled, removed from the tab order, activation blocked, href kept. Buttons: sets the native disabled property; unset leaves it alone.

options.name: label
options.description: Accessible name; required for icon-only buttons.

options.name: pressed
options.description: Toggle button: aria-pressed, flips on activation; null or unset is an ordinary button (buttons only).

properties.name: element
properties.description: The enhanced native button or link.

events.name: aui-change
events.description: A toggle button was activated by the user: { pressed }.

contentAreas.name: label
contentAreas.description: Existing child text/elements of the native button.

cssClasses.name: aui-button--pressed
cssClasses.description: Toggle button in the pressed state.

cssClasses.name: aui-button__spinner
cssClasses.description: Loading spinner; animation removed under reduced motion.
